description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and toggling states like archiving, restoring, pinning, and trashing notes. It incorporates filtering, soft-deletion via title prefixes, and real-time broadcasting of note changes.

methods.name: _apply_note_filters( stmt, search: Optional[str], tag: Optional[str], pinned: Optional[bool], archived: Optional[bool], trashed: Optional[bool], )
methods.description: Utility to apply search and tag filters on SQLAlchemy select statement to filter notes.

methods.name: List[Tag] _resolve_tags_by_ids(db: Session, tag_ids: Optional[List[int]])
methods.description: Resolves list of tag IDs to Tag objects, validating existence.

methods.name: str _ensure_no_duplicate_prefix(title: str, prefix: str)
methods.description: Ensures a title has a single prefix among the recognized prefixes by removing duplicates.
